description: Defines classes, structs, and interfaces for UE scheduling in a wireless communication system, including resource allocation, event handling, and cell management.

classes.name: ue_cell_scheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling UE grants per cell, including slot execution, error handling, and reconfiguration.

classes.name: ue_scheduler
classes.description: Interface for managing multiple UE cell schedulers, including adding and removing cells.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE cell scheduler instance, returning a RAII handler.

methods.name: do_add_cell
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented for creating a new cell scheduler.

methods.name: do_rem_cell
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented for removing a cell scheduler.
